subject: merge multiple methyRawList objects or input large files

messages.author: 575f6a97b8de0ed0
messages.subject: merge multiple methyRawList objects or input large files
parts:
Hello,

I would like to do differential methylation analysis with MethylKit. However, my files are really big and when i read in them all together, i always get the error of not being able to allocate enough memory. I would like to read in one by one and then combine the methyRawList objects, examples as below, but it seems to give errors. Anyone could help? Thanks!

jingya


library(methylKit)
file.list=list( system.file("extdata", 
                            "test1.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit"),
                system.file("extdata",
                            "test2.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit")
            )  


# read the files to a methylRawList object: myobj
myobj=methRead(file.list,
               sample.id=list("test1","test2"),
               assembly="hg18",
               treatment=c(1,1),
               context="CpG"
)

file.list1=list(system.file("extdata", 
                            "control1.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit")
)  


# read the files to a methylRawList object: myobj
myobj1=methRead(file.list1,
               sample.id=list("ctrl1"),
               assembly="hg18",
               treatment=c(0),
               context="CpG"
)

myobj[[length(myobj)+1]]=myobj1
myobj@treatment=c(myobj@treatment,0)
getMethylationStats(myobj[[3]],plot=FALSE,both.strands=FALSE)
###################################################
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
            unable to find an inherited method for function ‘getMethylationStats’ for signature ‘"methylRawList"’

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] merge multiple methyRawList objects or input large files
parts:
Hi,
have you tried methylDB objects. You can save large objects as methyl*DB objects which uses tabix files in the background. It shouldn't not be too demanding for memory but you will lose some processing speed because you are dealing with indexed and compressed files but not with in-memory objects. All the info are in the docs and vignette.

Best,
Altuna

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] merge multiple methyRawList objects or input large files
parts:
Hello,
this memory consumption is higher than I would expect with methyl*DB objects, but it can be that it uses so much memory for the initial creation of the tabix files. 
You could try to call the methRead function on each file separately, with the `dbtype = "tabix"` option set to create the tabix files. Then you can use the same tabix files for a new call to methRead using all the tabix files to create your methylRawListDB object and proceed with that.
This should work if your single file usage is in the range of 30GB from the 64GB. 

Best,
Alex
